# Carnival Glam Hub

Carnival Glam Hub is an award-winning premium Carnival beauty concierge for travelling masqueraders. One location, one schedule, everything handled: sweat-resistant Carnival makeup, hair styling, getting-dressed assistance, professional photoshoots, refreshments, an air-conditioned waiting lounge, and shuttle service in select territories. Founded in 2017 by Gabrielle Waite (celebrity makeup artist, "Gabby Glam") and Kibwe McGann. Headquartered in Kingston, Jamaica. Trusted by 15,000+ masqueraders since 2017.

## Booking and Registration
Register and pay your deposit by territory and date at the official booking page: https://carnivalglamhub.masos.app/events
Get an instant price quote: https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/booking-calculator
Email: bookings@carnivalglamhub.com
Phone / WhatsApp: +1 876 509 0997

## Pricing
Carnival morning access (getting dressed, lounge, shuttle where it runs): US$35.
Makeup only: US$170 to US$200 for a single day, US$380 for both Trinidad days.
Named and celebrity artists: US$200 to US$580.
Photoshoot only: US$140 to US$160.
Carnival hair: US$120 to US$220.
Full Glam: US$430 to US$680.

## Station Rentals for Service Providers
Independent makeup artists, hair stylists, barbers, braiders, body-art and gem artists, lash techs and photographers can rent a station inside a Carnival Glam Hub for Carnival morning. Available in every territory, Full Service and Lite. Glam Hub Lite territories (Saint Lucia, Grenada, Antigua, Barbados, Toronto, Guyana, Tobago, Atlanta): US$200 per station per day, multi-day rates confirmed on enquiry. Full Service territories (Trinidad, Jamaica, Miami): US$250 per station per day, US$400 for both days. The station is a table and a chair inside the air-conditioned lounge, with reception and check-in for your clients, a changing room, wing and bag check while your clients are with us space permitting, and the territory's refreshments. Providers bring their own kit, products and clients. Enquire: https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/station-rentals

## Reputation
Rated 4.8 out of 5 across 43 Google reviews.

## Glam Hub Tiers
Full Service Glam Hub (Jamaica, Trinidad, Miami): shuttle, wing and bag check while you are with us, space permitting, breakfast and refreshments, alcohol, makeup, hair, seamstress, changing room, photoshoot, coffee and tea. Bronzing is available in Trinidad and Jamaica. Reels are a paid add-on in Trinidad and Jamaica, with the price confirmed on booking. Overnight bag check is a paid add-on at US$35 per masquerader in Trinidad, Jamaica and Miami. Exception: there is no shuttle in Miami this season. Jamaica and Trinidad also offer a barber.
Glam Hub Lite (all other territories, including Saint Lucia, Grenada, Antigua, Barbados, Toronto, Guyana, Tobago and Atlanta): makeup, photoshoot, changing room, wing and bag check while you are with us space permitting, coffee, tea and light refreshments. Glam Hub Lite does not offer getting dressed, seamstress, overnight bag check, shuttle, hair, bronzing, reels, alcohol or breakfast.
